prompt: Name a school in the Big Ten conference.

answers.name: Ohio State
answers.fact: The Horseshoe seats over 100,000, among the largest stadiums in the country.

answers.name: Michigan
answers.fact: The Big House is the largest stadium in the United States.

answers.name: Penn State
answers.fact: Joined in 1990, the first expansion beyond the original midwestern core.

answers.name: Wisconsin
answers.fact: Camp Randall Stadium sits on the site of a Civil War training camp.

answers.name: Michigan State
answers.fact: Plays Michigan each year for the Paul Bunyan Trophy.

answers.name: Iowa
answers.fact: The visitors' locker room at Kinnick Stadium is painted entirely pink.

answers.name: Nebraska
answers.fact: Joined in 2011 after more than a century in the Big Eight and Big 12.

answers.name: Indiana
answers.fact: Long better known for basketball, with five national titles.

answers.name: Minnesota
answers.fact: Plays Wisconsin for Paul Bunyan's Axe, the most-played rivalry in major college football.

answers.name: Illinois
answers.fact: A charter member. The conference was founded in Chicago in 1896.

answers.name: Northwestern
answers.fact: The only private university in the conference.

answers.name: Maryland
answers.fact: Joined in 2014, leaving the ACC after six decades.

answers.name: Rutgers
answers.fact: Played in the first college football game, against Princeton in 1869.

answers.name: UCLA
answers.fact: Joined in 2024, and plays its home games at the Rose Bowl rather than on campus.

answers.name: Oregon
answers.fact: Joined in 2024. Its uniform combinations run into the hundreds.

answers.name: Washington
answers.fact: Joined in 2024, and is both the westernmost and northernmost member.
